matter_and.name: Matter / AND
matter_and.description: Tabletop physical AND, 1.8 by 0.85 metres: two 12 cm cubes fill real gaps. A white marble reaches the receiver only when both gaps support it. Hand-sized front controls and lift grip; individually editable construction parts.
matter_and.qfep_connection: The clean conjunction is a prediction. Contact, friction, dimensions and timing determine whether the physical construction fulfils it; an observed mismatch stays visible.
